prompt: What is the available 24-hour liquidity across every entity and currency, normalized to USD?

results.text: Available 24-hour liquidity across every entity and currency is **USD 52.16 million**, normalized to US dollars, as of the demo logical clock. That is USD 7.84 million below the USD 60 million illustrative policy buffer.

sql.command: SELECT SUM(available_liquidity_24h_usd) AS available_liquidity_24h_usd FROM aa_liquidity_position
